scheme_name: Meritorious Scholarships To Vjnt And Sbc Students Studying In Secondary Schools
other_conditions: Student must have secured more than 50 percent marks in the previous year's annual examination and stood first or second in the class.
Student should belong to VJNT/SBC category.
Student should be studying in 5th to 10th standard.
benefits_summary: Students receive ₹200 per annum for standards 5th‑7th and ₹400 per annum for standards 8th‑10th.
